integrity: The exact optimization and spectral frontier are derived in RESULT.md. Independent scientific review has not been performed. No new probabilistic time integrator is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Diagonal linear constrained three-state benchmark; two dynamic Gaussian coordinates with one shared positive scale; terminal marginal Bhattacharyya objective only; no claim for mode-dependent covariance, full trajectory optimum or nonlinear systems.
title: An exact spectral calibration gap for probabilistic implicit Euler under a linear constraint
